title: Balanced pairs, virtually Gorenstein rings, and cotorsion torsion triples
summary: For any ring $R$, we investigate balanced pairs of classes of modules and their relations to cotorsion triples. We characterize the special balanced pairs that fit into complete hereditary cotorsion triples. As an application, we prove that Gorenstein projective and Gorenstein injective modules form a balanced pair, if and only if $R$ is right virtually Gorenstein. We also characterize the tilting and cotilting cotorsion pairs arising from balanced pairs.
